data.text: I commit to 15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000, provided John, Kate, and Jack also commit and Luke stays at zero. My family taught me to protect this lake, but keeping essential treatment available matters to our village too. Let’s agree now that next month we each take no more than 6 tons, then return to a 50-ton total monthly limit once the lake recovers. John, are you willing to join this one-time plan?
